about.description: The Shipp family returns to Orange Beach with two distinct culinary experiences: dockside seafood and sushi on the lower deck and Chef Matt's signature dishes with craft cocktails on the upscale yet relaxed upper deck.
about.elevator_pitch: A waterfront seafood restaurant at Orange Beach Marina offering casual dockside dining on the lower deck and upscale full-service dining on the upper deck.
about.vibe: Casual counter service on lower deck, family-friendly full-service upscale yet relaxed atmosphere on upper deck
about.insider_tip: Two distinct dining experiences in one location - choose between casual dockside seafood or upscale dining with craft cocktails
